line: קניתי בגללו ארבע מאות קילו תותים

deliverables.alternate_take: video/alternates/lume-pilot-v1-alt-take2-1920x1080.mp4 (same specs; calmer head and paw movement)
deliverables.dialogue_as_muxed: audio/lume-line-v1-as-muxed-final-4s.wav (same line, 400 ms lead-in, padded to 4.0 s)

audio.cut: 2.840 to 5.275 s of the 21.89 s take (cut_line.sh): sample-accurate trim, 15 ms fade in, 40 ms fade out, no other processing. Speech occupies 0.109 to 2.335 s of the cut.
audio.wording_check: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (via fal) on the full take put the line at 2.96 to 5.20 s; on the cut it returned exactly the line and nothing else (fal requests 01a12fe3-8cbc-71e3-9530-7a620aedaf60 and 01a12ff3-56e6-7652-9af2-e0ed7157b325).
audio.other_takes: audio/candidates/line_B..D are the same line cut from the three Lume-voice settings tests (jobs ec7b2ab5, bbac653f, f4e5fb1d); not used.

still.model: gpt_image_2_5 (GPT Image 2.5), aspect_ratio 16:9, resolution 2k, quality high, variant flare (default)
still.master_1920x1080: native 2688x1520 scaled to 1920x1086 (Lanczos), 3 px cropped top and bottom

rejected.still-v1-a / still-v1-b (nano_banana_fla: off-model: oversized head, long muzzle, big nose, extra teeth; v1-a also lost the whiskers and shrank the chair
rejected.still-v2-* (prompts/still-v2.txt): on-model (except nano_banana_pro, which lost the fur) but Lume sat too low: microphone level with his nose instead of below his mouth
rejected.still-v3-gpt25-b: microphone arm moved, scared rather than indignant
rejected.still-v3-nb2: scowl too heavy, extra teeth, red blotch on the table
rejected.still-v3-nb21 (nano_banana_2_1): close second: plate kept pixel-exact, but Lume larger, paler fur, less mitten-like paws

still.known_deviation: GPT Image 2.5 re-rendered the room instead of keeping the plate pixel-exact: layout, microphone and lighting match, the chair back sits slightly lower (qc/still__plate_vs_still.jpg).

video.model: wan2_7 (Wan 2.7), aspect_ratio 16:9, resolution 1080p, duration 4, start_image = master still 1920x1080, audio_references = audio/lume-line-v1-padded-4s.wav (line with 500 ms lead-in)
video.native_output: 1920x1080, H.264, 30 fps, 120 frames; its own audio track is the reference audio unchanged (waveform cross-correlation 0.999 at 0 ms)

alternate.note: same settings, movement constrained in the prompt

rejected.model: seedance_2_5, mode omni_reference, 1080p, duration 4, bitrate_mode high, generate_audio true, same start image and audio reference
rejected.reason: Treated the audio as a style reference and re-voiced the line: its audio is a different recording (cross-correlation 0.11) running 0.70 to 3.69 s instead of 0.62 to 2.77 s, so its lip movement cannot match the real take. Picture quality and identity were fine.

final_assembly.tool: mux_final.sh (ffmpeg): video stream copied without re-encoding; original line placed with a lead-in and encoded AAC 192 kb/s 48 kHz stereo
final_assembly.sync_correction: Wan 2.7 moved the mouth about 100 ms ahead of the sound (take 1) and about 67 ms ahead (take 2). The line was therefore placed 100 ms earlier in the final (lead-in 400 ms) and 67 ms earlier in the alternate (lead-in 433 ms).

checks.method: qc/inspect_video.py: ffprobe facts, waveform cross-correlation of the clip's audio against the dialogue file, per-frame nose tracking and mouth-opening measure against the audio envelope, background drift in four static regions; plus frame sheets viewed by Claude. Not listened to by ear.
checks.final_mouth_vs_audio: best alignment within one frame (mouth 33 ms ahead); mouth active 0.53 to 2.73 s, closed afterwards; closures land on the b of בגללו and ארבע and the m of מאות and תותים, rounded shapes on the o/u syllables, within about 2 frames (qc/final__mouth_per_frame_vs_words.jpg)
checks.final_background: camera locked; microphone, chair, shelves unchanged first to last frame (qc/final__first_vs_last_frame_diff.jpg); drift in static regions 1.4 to 3.6 of 255 on average

remaining_issues: Raised paw shows a pink paw pad that is not in Lume's reference design (both takes).
Head dips about 110 px on ארבע מאות in the final: livelier than 'restrained'. The alternate take is calmer (29 x 72 px) but shows a row of lower teeth for about 6 frames and a red paw pad.
Lip shapes follow syllables to within about 2 frames, not frame-exact; the rounded mouth on לו overhangs by about 3 frames.
Mouth is already open in the first frame (inherited from the still) for 0.5 s before he speaks.
Still: room is a faithful re-render, not the pixel-exact plate; chair back slightly lower.
Voice performance itself was not judged by ear.
credits_note: Higgsfield balance 982.58 before, 892.33 after: 90.25 credits for 10 stills and 3 videos (Seedance 2.5 take 48, each Wan 2.7 take 10, stills 2 to 2.75 each, plus cost-check uploads).
